name: AppleMachines
summary: Plot-simulator income: every machine a player has placed on their plot earns them the currency every second (base income times its level, times their rebirth and upgrade multipliers), their own presses can pay extra, and a rebirth trades all progress for a permanent multiplier.

needs.config: AppleGameConfig.machines = { [itemId] = { income = number per second at level 1, perPress = number? paid per press of the owner's own copy } }; AppleGameConfig.rebirth = { cost, growth, multiplier } (defaults 1000, 2, 0.5)
needs.shop: AppleShop: placed models in Workspace.AppleDefenders with attributes Owner (UserId number), Item (item id), Level
needs.optional: AppleUpgrades: ReplicatedStorage.AppleUpgradesConfig and player attributes Upgrade_<id> (multiplier upgrades raise the pay; rebirth zeroes the levels); AppleAnimate: ServerStorage.AppleAnimatePressed for perPress

gives.income: every second each owner is paid the sum of income(item, level) of their machines times multiplier(player) through economy.grant (reason machine)
gives.rebirth: ReplicatedStorage.AppleRebirth() -> ok, message: when money >= floor(rebirth.cost * rebirth.growth ^ rebirths) it sets money back to the economy start, destroys the player's placed models, sets every Upgrade_<id> to 0 and adds 1 to the saved Rebirths
gives.attributes: player attributes Rebirths, RebirthCost, Multiplier, IncomePerSecond for any screen
gives.state: ReplicatedStorage.AppleState (Configuration) with Phase = play when the game has no AppleWaves, so the HUD never waits for waves
gives.screen: AppleMachinesClient (LocalScript): AppleHUD.Coins.PerSecond shows IncomePerSecond; Menu.Rebirth opens RebirthPanel (Info, Bonus, Confirm -> AppleRebirth)

limits: Saved rebirths need the economy's DataStore (a published place); otherwise they last for the session.
